card.name: Linking words before white blood cell terms
card.fires_on: Small linking or qualifying words (total, or, and, low, in, of) right before a white blood cell term such as WBC, neutrophil, leukocyte or white blood cell count. Seen in blood-count monitoring and neutropenia warnings.

modes.label: Qualifier before WBC
modes.description: Words like low or total placed just before white blood cell count or WBC.
modes.example: include pre-existing<< low>> white blood cell count (WBC)

modes.label: Link between blood counts
modes.description: The word or or and joining platelet and neutrophil or similar counts.
modes.example: The cyclical pattern of platelet<< and>> neutrophil decreases and recovery remain consistent

modes.label: Reduction or monitoring of counts
modes.description: The word in or of after reduction or monitoring, before leukocyte or white cell counts.
modes.example: Periodic monitoring<< of>> white blood cell counts in patients with collagen
